title: Richmond
html_source: The Richmond Lunatic Asylum, referred to earlier in the chapter by Mulligan as “Dottyville”. Evidently it is another one of Buck’s placements for his medical training along with the Mater Misericordiae. Still the site of a psychiatric hospital today, the Richmond asylum was later renamed Grangegorman Mental Hospital, then St. Brendan’s Hospital, and finally today is known as the Phoenix Care Centre.
